title: Lawrence B NDE 4785
content: I went to my dentist to have two teeth extracted. The dentist told me not to eat because I was to be anesthetized with gas. I sat in the chair and he injected me with Lidocaine instead. It was the worst thing he could have done. Soon after the extractions, my nightmare of sickness began. Although later into the experience, it was marvelous. As I sat waiting for my next appointment, a terrible feeling came upon me. I began to feel sickly, dizzy and I felt a nasty pain in my chest that was getting more and more intense. Suddenly, I began to get pain in my throat and neck and down my left arm. I fell forward and down to the floor. I saw myself falling in stages as if photographing my descent from outside my body. I hit the floor and began to urinate, as I had no control over my bladder. I had drank three cups of coffee prior to my appointment, as I had no breakfast. Everyone in the waiting room began to panic. Then a woman and a man turned me over on to my back. I could see myself lying there dead as a doornail. Someone screamed and said 'Give him respiration.' I saw I wasn't responding. The woman opened the door and shouted for my sister who was outside smoking. It was then that I was drawn towards the outside and to a white Jaguar car parked nearby. As I approached the car from outside my body, the door opened and I was compelled to enter and sit behind the wheel. In a blinking of an eye the car sped off and spun right, just missing a green Volvo parked on the opposite side. It then headed straight for the door of the workingmen's club. I could hear and feel the impact and bricks smashing down onto the car. Then a high-pitched sound followed. A blinding flash brought me into a railway tunnel travelling at intense speed towards a light in the distance. In no time, I was at the light. When I got out of the car, I was greeted by a young girl and boy of about eighteen years of age, 'Welcome Lawrence,' they both said in unison as I found it hard to look at them face on. As I looked at them with squinting eyes, I noticed another entrance to my left blocked by a door. To the right of the door and to my front was a gate and a fence. Beyond that was a beautiful garden with large conifer trees running alongside a path that led slightly inclined towards a large glass, marble-like mansion of some kind. If you go through the gate, you will see your friends and family, it was in my head like ESP they were not speaking out from their mouths. Suddenly, as I gazed at the mansion, I was lifted some eighteen inches from the floor. I saw over the incline and saw lots of similar buildings with people walking around. Some sat at tables made of the same material as the buildings. As I looked on in amazement, a cinema screen appeared in front of me. I saw myself in a film of myself. It started when I was about five years old onwards, showing all the details from childhood right through to old age. Then the film changed to people suffering in desert countries and I saw earthquakes and large water waves covering peoples' villages. I saw the USA air fleet attacking an Arab country and devastating it like they did at Hiroshima and Nagasaki. I thought the country was Iran. The USA had developed a secret weapon unlike anything ever seen on earth. Medical discoveries gave new treatments for ailments and an end to horrible diseases was the topic of the report I was hearing. After a while, the screen vanished and I floated back down to the floor. The two beings said again in unison 'Do you want to go through the gate Lawrence? Because if you do, you won't be able to go back.' They asked, 'Who are you with?' I answered, that I am with my sister but somehow I'm not. I'm in two places. They asked, 'Do you then want to be with your sister or go through the gate?' I moved forward, opened the gate, and thought for a while. I didn't want to leave, but I didn't want to leave my sister either. 'Do you know where you are Lawrence?' I said 'yes' and that I wanted to be with my sister Patricia. Immediately, I found myself hurtling at top speed back through the tunnel. A blinding flash brought me back to the road and back to the dental surgery. I saw my sister dragging my lifeless body out of the surgery. I walked up to her and lay down on top of my body, wherein I came back to life. I kept repeating 'The tunnel, the tunnel.' My sister's aid said, 'You are coming with me, I know where you've been.' I went home and was okay next day. Ever since then, I've had premonitions that have all come true. I have been able to predict the future, I have also seen events weeks before they have happened - everything said here is the truth.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Saw himself falling 'in stages' from outside his body; later was 'drawn' outside toward a parked car.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Travelling at 'intense speed' toward a distant light; later 'hurtling at top speed back through the tunnel' on return.

arrival.other_being_detail: Two 'beings' who appeared as a young girl and boy about eighteen; greeted him by name and communicated telepathically ('in my head like ESP').

environment.environment_other_detail: Gate and fence; beautiful garden with large conifer trees along a path leading uphill to a large glass/marble-like mansion; many similar buildings; people walking around; some sitting at tables made of the same material as the buildings.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Dental extractions under local anesthetic (Lidocaine); became acutely ill with chest/throat/neck/left arm pain and collapsed in the waiting room.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Transitional episode of being compelled into a white Jaguar car that crashed, followed by a high-pitched sound and blinding flash into the tunnel; later returned by laying on top of his body.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE included an unusual 'car' sequence before entering the tunnel/light/realm.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Reported being 'in two places' (with his sister but somehow not) while in the other realm.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Compelled into a white Jaguar during the OBE; car sped off, crashed into a building with bricks smashing down; high-pitched sound and blinding flash preceded entry into a railway tunnel. A 'cinema screen' showed his life from age ~5 through old age, then shifted to scenes of global suffering, earthquakes/waves, and a USA attack on an Arab country (thought to be Iran) with a secret weapon; also 'medical discoveries' ending diseases.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I saw myself falling in stages as if photographing my descent from outside my body."; "I could see myself lying there dead as a doornail."; "If you go through the gate, you will see your friends and family, it was in my head like ESP"; "Do you want to go through the gate Lawrence? Because if you do, you won't be able to go back."; "Immediately, I found myself hurtling at top speed back through the tunnel."; "Ever since then, I've had premonitions that have all come true."
